summary: Centrifugo is a self-hosted server designed for language-agnostic real-time messaging using protocols like WebSocket or SockJS. It allows applications to push updates to clients instantly and manage bi-directional communication channels at scale. The software is written in Go and can be deployed via Docker or Kubernetes.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you need to add real-time features to a stack that uses multiple programming languages and you prefer to run your own messaging infrastructure.
watchOut: Operating a persistent real-time messaging server introduces additional infrastructure complexity compared to standard stateless HTTP backends, particularly around connection management and horizontal scaling.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination properly, and you may need to configure an external broker depending on your scaling requirements.
